title: Getting Started — Home, Settings and Company Profile
purpose: Find your way around QMAS: the Home page, the top bar and your company settings.
overview: **Home** shows quick workflows, items that need your attention, and an overview of your business.
The **top bar** has analytics, messages, notifications, settings, help and credits.
**Settings** (gear icon) opens Company Profile, Password, Languages, Account Management and Assign TicMart Job.

body: **TicMate** asks “What would you like to do today?” and lists quick workflows:

list: **Generate product risk assessment report** (AI Assessment workflow).
**Request product testing with your lab partner** (Product Testing).
**Request technical files from your supplier/factory** (Document Review).
**CPSC eFiling**. If it shows “API Setup Required”, set up your Certifier ID in Company Profile first.

body: **Attention** counts the items that need action in each module, such as Product Testing, Document Review, QC Inspection, IQC Inspection, Factory Audit, Pending Review Doc and Expired Doc. Click a card to see them.
**Business Overview** shows your active products, suppliers, factories and partners. Click **›** to open the list.
**Ask TicMate** on the right edge opens the TicMate assistant.
Click the gear icon in the top bar:

table: Company details, certificates, documents, product categories and CPSC eFiling Certifier ID.
Assign jobs from the TicMart marketplace.

body: Click the pencil icon next to the company name to edit it. The **Overview**, **Certificate** and **Document** tabs hold your company information. **CPSC eFiling - Certifier ID** is where you add and manage the API key for eFiling. **Product Category** lists the categories your company works with.

tips: The question-mark icon opens the QMAS Help Center.
The coin icon shows your credits and tokens for paid features such as AI Insight.
faq: How do I change the language?
Click the gear icon in the top bar, then Languages.
How do I change my password?
Click the gear icon in the top bar, then Password.
Where do I edit my company information?
Click the gear icon, then Company Profile (https://qmas.icw.io/company-profile).
